faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What architecture services do you offer in Karnal?

Planning, elevations, working drawings and consultant coordination for independent houses, kothis, commercial buildings and farmhouses.

Can you design a large independent house or kothi?

Yes. We plan family areas, guest rooms, puja room, courtyards, terraces and parking so the house works for joint families and visiting relatives.

Do you plan for local weather?

Yes. Orientation, shading, cross-ventilation and insulation are planned to handle hot summers and cold winters in Haryana.

Why choose architecture services and interiors from one firm?

The building and the interiors are designed together, so room sizes, windows, lighting and furniture fit each other and changes during construction are fewer.
